changes: Ported from JavaScript to C#. The Clear My Lists button is gone from the config screen, because config buttons have no UI: use /beams clear. The player's lists are now in lootbeams.lists.txt in the game's save folder, as plain text, because C# mods have no mod_data folder and no JSON library: lists saved by the JavaScript version are not read. Min Value is stored by its coin label (1c, 1s, 1g...), so a Min Value saved by the JavaScript version goes back to the default.
